_comment: Boss option (Boss 2026-11-21): every BOSS-DROP piece (a catalog item with a non-empty "boss") is gold and carries one status-on-hit proc that zone drops never have. Read by logic/boss_procs.gd. Key = catalog item id. On each landed hit (melee/projectile "hit" or class "skill_hit", never blocked, periodic, reflected or redirected) of the wearer on a living enemy, an option that is off cooldown rolls `chance` percent (own derived RNG, the sim stream is untouched); a trigger starts its internal cooldown `icd` (ticks, 60 = 1 s) whether or not the status then lands. The status itself goes through logic/effects.gd apply() with base 100: it lands at 100 + the wearer's EFFECT/group/per-effect ACC - the target's RES (resistance >= 100 = immune: CTRL_RES 100 bosses never get a control status). `duration` (ticks) overrides the status's own. Two copies of the same piece (earring/bracelet/ring x2) give ONE option. A destroyed or broken-down (durability 0) piece gives none. Rules (validated by tests/test_boss_procs.gd): chance in [chance_min, chance_max]; icd > duration (cannot chain into permanent uptime); a control status (stun/shock/sleep) only on a weapon and at most weapon_control_max_ticks; statuses are distinct within one boss. PLACEHOLDER numbers until the Boss plays.
_swap: 2026-11-21: the Orc Warlock (data/loot/boss_loot.json orc_camp) pays its own set boss_orc_warlock (night camp: tusk necklace curse, bone hook earring bleed, iron-studded bracer sunder, ember skull ring burn, night hide cloak slow). A new boss set adds one entry per piece here; tests/test_boss_procs.gd fails while a boss piece has no option.
